propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' errors for bare 4-hex commit subject prefixes that match multiple tickets, then the CLI process hangs for minutes even after the close has committed durably.

The post-write hang is caused by _find_fixing_commit re-resolving bug_id on every commit in the branch history without memoization or quiet-mode, triggering O(commits × tickets) alias scanning that takes ~9 minutes.
The terminal noise is emitted by _resolves_to and _commit_ticket when they resolve candidates from commit subjects without quiet=True, treating unqualified 4-hex fragments as ticket references.
Bare 4-digit (single-quad) hex references are being deprecated in documentation and should no longer be advertised as a supported reference form.

The fix requires passing quiet=True at all scanner call sites, hoisting loop-invariant bug_id resolution, memoizing ref resolutions, and short-circuiting hex-quad shapes that cannot prefix the target.
Commit-subject resolution semantics are unchanged; all existing id forms (canonical id, 8-hex two-quad prefix, alias, Jira key, unambiguous 4-hex) must still resolve.
